shots.prompt: The camera very slowly pushes in on an arcane magician's theater stage turned into a burger kitchen. Glowing red, orange, lime-green and yellow triangle crystal shards float in the air and rotate slowly. Smoke and haze drift low across the mirror-black floor. Warm volumetric god rays shimmer from above, candles and lamps flicker, dust motes sparkle, and the golden arcane circle on the floor pulses softly. The curtains, floor and composition stay exactly as in the first frame and the central space stays empty and dark. AAA game main-menu background, Unreal Engine 5 look, calm continuous ambient motion.

Static camera. The wand mascot spins once in the air and casts a spell: its crystal tip flashes, a burst of golden sparks and colourful triangle shards explodes beside it, and a huge juicy gourmet cheeseburger with melting cheese, fresh lettuce and a glossy sesame bun materializes floating in the air next to it, steam curling upward. The wand presents the burger with an open gloved hand and a confident smile, and the burger keeps floating, glossy and steaming, to the end. The dark background stays dark. Premium 3D animated-feature look, Pixar and Blizzard game-cinematic quality, warm golden key light with orange rim light, red, orange, lime-green and yellow triangle confetti shards, glossy appetizing materials, sharp detail, smooth fluid motion.

Blizzard-style epic game cinematic summoning. The camera starts on the magic wand mid-cast. It whips through a powerful spell-casting arc trailing a ribbon of molten golden fire; the vortex spins faster above the ignited golden arcane circle, crystal shards and sparks are pulled into its center, a blinding flash, and a gigantic gourmet double cheeseburger materializes layer by layer inside the vortex: bun, melting cheddar, juicy patties, lettuce, tomato, steam rising. The camera dollies around the burger like a legendary item reveal, then settles as the wand floats beside it and presents it proudly with an open gloved hand. Epic god rays, embers, cinematic lighting.

Static centered close-up on a pure black background. A soft golden spark hangs in the center. It bursts into a swirl of golden and orange sparkles and tiny red, orange, lime-green and yellow triangle shards that spiral inward and condense into the signature ABRACADABRA burger: a towering double burger with a golden glazed bun, two patties, molten cheese, crispy bacon and special sauce, topped with a tiny star-shaped pick. The dish builds itself piece by piece in a burst of warm light, then settles floating in the center of the frame, turning slowly about fifteen degrees, with gentle steam or a soft shimmer rising and a few sparkles drifting around it until the last frame. Glossy, appetizing 3D animated-feature look, warm rim light, shallow depth of field, solid black background throughout.
